text: The 2023 tree removal on the asset was detected as a 0.7-hectare loss of tree cover, primarily involving Eucalyptus plantations (0.4 ha) and some unmapped forest (0.3 ha). While the evidence confirms the removal occurred, it does not determine whether it was authorized. The data shows the change was likely a planned harvest or clearing (given the plantation context and patch size), but it does not provide legal or regulatory details. No evidence links the event to deforestation, land-use change, or compliance status (e.g., EUDR). Further investigation would require local permits, landowner records, or regulatory reports.
